scope: Tracked and nonignored untracked public files, every decompressed ZIP/wheel member, and final figure content and metadata; private clinical directories were not accessed for this audit.
raw_clinical_images_crops_manifests_and_: Kept outside the public repository and all public archives.
public_author_identity: Public author name and ORCID are intentionally retained; the wheel has no author email and no private correspondence file is included.
synthetic_pattern_matches: Deliberate redaction-test paths, a path-detection regex, reserved example.invalid addresses, matrix expressions and an unchanged compressed-pixel coincidence were distinguished from private content.
substantive_assistance_disclosure: The public instruction to disclose substantive assistance is retained; it is not an accidental execution trace.
figure_review: Final figures contain a declared synthetic phantom, method diagrams and aggregate results. Metadata and copied public graphical-abstract assets were checked; no raw clinical imagery or identifiers were found.
limitation: Snapshot-specific pattern, payload, metadata and visual review, not a universal anonymization guarantee. Later file changes require a new check; ignored local build material is outside the publication set.
